map.算法：污染指数 Pi=Cn/Sn（Sn 为评价标准），超标倍数=(Cn−Sn)/: Algorithm: pollution index Pi=Cn/Sn (Sn is the assessment standard), exceedance multiple=(Cn−Sn)/Sn, enrichment factor=Cn/Bn (Bn is the background), geo-accumulation index Igeo=log₂(Cn/(1.5·Bn)…
map.单因子评价：由实测浓度、背景值、评价标准算污染指数 Pi 与超标倍数: Single-factor assessment: from the measured concentration, background and standard, compute the pollution index Pi and the exceedance multiple
map.富集判定：用地累积指数 Igeo 评估人为污染程度: Enrichment assessment: use the geo-accumulation index Igeo to evaluate the degree of anthropogenic pollution
map.场地分级：按 Igeo 分级指导修复优先级: Site classification: use the Igeo class to guide remediation priority
map.Pi 和 Igeo 哪个更权威？: Which is more authoritative, Pi or Igeo?
map.Pi 是国内场地调查常用的单因子/内梅罗指数基础，直观易比标准；Igeo（Mül: Pi is the single-factor/Nemerow index base commonly used in Chinese site surveys, intuitive and easy to compare against standards; Igeo (Müller) introduces a background value and a coefficient of 1.5 to separate natural background from anthropogenic enrichment, ideal for identifying pollution sources. The two are complementary and often reported side by side.
map.Igeo 出现负值说明什么？: What does a negative Igeo indicate?
map.Igeo<0 表示实测浓度低于背景的 1.5 倍，视为无人为污染（甚至低于自然背: Igeo<0 means the measured concentration is below 1.5x the background, treated as free of anthropogenic contamination (even below natural background variation), which is within the safe range; but this does not mean other pollutants are safe — each contaminant of interest must be evaluated separately.
